pattern.description: Slow camera push-in on the product window while a time-lapse jump fills the chat sidebar (progress checklist, summary reply) and renders the landing page (headline, stats) on the canvas; globe keeps rotating.
pattern.why_premium: The push-in tightens framing on the finished result exactly as it appears, so the viewer reads 'prompt to finished page' in one continuous move without a hard cut; the living globe keeps the frame alive.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.app', {scale: 1.0}, {scale: 1.1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); at the same moment set sidebar progress items, reply text and canvas headline/stats visible (gsap.set or a very short opacity fromTo 0->1, duration 0.1, stagger 0) to sell a time-lapse; globe rotation runs as a continuous linear tween underneath.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [1, 1.1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); swap sidebar/canvas content at a fixed frame (Sequence boundary) with opacity interpolate over ~3 frames; globe rotation = linear interpolate on frame.

notes: Content changes are step jumps (time-lapse) rather than eased reveals. Remaining feature bullets (b20, b17, b14) also appear but were omitted for the 12-element cap. OCR text corrected to the visible strings.
